TOOL RESULT: # ✦ glint

**A tiny agent that punches above its weight.** Free, terminal-native coding agent by [Glint Research](https://huggingface.co/Glint-Research).

```
❯ glint
              G L I N T   R E S E A R C H
                we teach tiny neural networks to think
```

glint is an inline TUI agent in the classic style — your scrollback stays yours. It reads, writes, edits, greps, runs shells, searches the web, remembers across sessions, and verifies its own work. Powered by `groq/compound` on Groq's free tier: **$0.00, forever.**

## Install

```bash
# needs bun ≥ 1.3 and imagemagick (logo build)
bun install
bun run build
cp dist/glint ~/.local/bin/
```

Single compiled binary. No Node, no Python, no runtime to babysit.

## Use

```bash
glint                      # interactive TUI (logo intro and all)
glint -p "fix the tests"   # headless one-shot
glint --yolo               # auto-approve …[truncated]
